name: EDMA
summary: EDMA, also known as 3,4-ethylenedioxy-N-methylamphetamine or as MDMC, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and EDxx families. It is an analogue of MDMA where the methylenedioxy ring has been replaced by an ethylenedioxy ring.

pharmacology.text: It has been found that EDMA acts as a non-neurotoxic serotonin releasing agent with moderately diminished potency relative to MDMA, and with negligible effects on dopamine release. However, subsequent research found that EMDA is a serotonin–norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) with EC50 values of 117 nM for serotonin release, 325 nM for norepinephrine release, and 597 nM for dopamine release in rat brain synaptosomes.
